lines.text: Many learners say: I want a coffee.
Better: I would like a coffee.
Would like! I would like a glass of water.

native.tip: 한국어 “커피 마시고 싶어요”의 ‘-고 싶어요’는 공손하지만, 주문할 때 I want를 쓰면 영어에선 직설적으로 들려요. I would like를 써요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I would like a coffee.”

en.tip: Would like is kinder than want when you ask. Say “I would like a coffee.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I want a coffee.” Would like is kinder than want when you ask. Right: “I would like a coffee.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
